text:
[Council File 26-1427]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to establishing a Citywide data privacy policy and supporting policies with standards and safeguards governing data collection, storage, retention, access, sharing, disclosure, cybersecurity, and protection of individual privacy.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez - Padilla, et al.):
INSTRUCT the Information Technology Agency, with the assistance of the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and other relevant departments, to report to Council with recommendations for establishing a Citywide data privacy policy and supporting policies applicable to all City and Proprietary departments, that establish standards and safeguards governing data collection, storage, retention, access, sharing and disclosure; cybersecurity and protection against unauthorized access or security breaches; appropriate and prohibited uses of City technology and data; transparency, accountability, oversight, and auditing requirements; and, any additional protections necessary to safeguard individual privacy and prevent the misuse of technology or information collected by the City.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to establish a citywide data privacy policy, with supporting standards and safeguards for how city data is collected, stored, kept, accessed, shared and secured, and for protecting individual privacy.
